blocks.text: Qisqargan ergash gap: who is / which was tushib qoladi

Aniqlovchi ergash gap (→ 92-dars) ko'pincha qisqartiriladi: **who / which** va **be** tushib qoladi, faqat **-ing** yoki **-ed** (V3) shakli qoladi. The woman **who is talking** to Tom → The woman **talking** to Tom. The boy **who was injured** in the accident → The boy **injured** in the accident. Bu shakl gapni ixcham qiladi, yangiliklar va rasmiy matnlarda juda ko'p uchraydi. O'zbek tilida xuddi shu vazifani sifatdoshlar bajaradi: «Tom bilan **gaplashayotgan** ayol», «avariyada **jarohatlangan** bola». Farqi — o'zbekchada sifatdosh otdan **oldin**, inglizchada esa ibora otdan **keyin** keladi.

rows: the woman **who is talking** to Tom
the boy **who was injured** in the accident
the money **which was stolen** from the bank

blocks.text: **-ing** iborasi **who / which + faol fe'l** o'rnida keladi. Ko'pincha ayni paytda yoki o'sha paytda bo'layotgan harakat: the man **sitting** next to me (= who is sitting / who was sitting). Lekin u doimiy xususiyatni ham bildiradi — bunda to'liq shakli Present Simple bo'ladi: a path **leading** to the lake (= which leads), a company **employing** 300 people (= which employs). Odatda Continuous da ishlatilmaydigan holat fe'llari ham bu yerda bemalol **-ing** oladi: a box **containing** old letters, land **belonging to** my uncle, a course **consisting of** ten lessons, anyone **wanting** a ticket.

items.text: The lady **selling** flowers outside the metro remembers all her customers.
items.translation: Metro oldida gul **sotadigan** ayol barcha xaridorlarini eslab qoladi.

items.text: We need a bridge **linking** the two halves of the town.
items.translation: Bizga shaharning ikki qismini **bog'laydigan** ko'prik kerak.

items.text: She sent me a link **containing** all the information about the course.
items.translation: U menga kurs haqidagi barcha ma'lumot **jamlangan** havolani yubordi.

blocks.text: Bir martalik, tugagan o'tgan zamon harakati uchun **-ing** ishlatilmaydi — to'liq ergash gap kerak: The man **who broke** the window has been arrested («The man breaking the window ...» — xato). Lekin o'sha paytda davom etayotgan harakat uchun mumkin: I saw a man **breaking** into a car (o'sha payt sindirayotgan edi).

**-ed** iborasi **who / which + majhul fe'l** (passive) o'rnida keladi: the boy **injured** in the accident (= who was injured), cars **made** in Japan (= which are made). Bu yerda shakl — fe'lning uchinchi shakli (V3), shuning uchun noto'g'ri fe'llarda **-ed** emas: built, made, written, stolen, held, known, taken, sold. O'zbekchada bunga **-(i)lgan / -ingan / -iladigan** to'g'ri keladi: qurilgan, yozilgan, sotiladigan. Majhul nisbat haqida batafsil → 42–44-darslar, noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati → qizil kitob, 117-dars.

rows: a café **known** for its fresh bread

items.text: Most of the vegetables **sold** at this market are grown locally.
items.translation: Bu bozorda **sotiladigan** sabzavotlarning aksariyati mahalliy yetishtirilgan.

items.text: The documents **found** in the old house were over a century old.
items.translation: Eski uydan **topilgan** hujjatlar bir asrdan ham qadimiy edi.

items.text: Questions **asked** during the interview were mostly about teamwork.
items.translation: Suhbat paytida **berilgan** savollar asosan jamoada ishlash haqida edi.

blocks.text: **there is / there are** dan keyin ham shu iboralar juda tabiiy: There's someone **waiting** for you (o'zbekchada: «Sizni bir kishi kutyapti»). There were ten people **injured** (o'nta odam jarohatlandi). Alohida e'tibor — **left** (leave fe'lining V3 si): bu yerda «qolgan, ortib qolgan» degani. There's no bread **left** — Non **qolmabdi**. Is there any tea **left**? — Choy **qoldimi**? We've got ten minutes **left** — O'n daqiqamiz **qoldi**.

items.text: There's a taxi **waiting** downstairs — are you ready?
There were hundreds of people **queuing** for tickets at the box office.
items.translation: Kassa oldida chipta uchun yuzlab odam **navbatda turgan edi**.

items.text: Have we got any petrol **left**, or should we stop at the next station?
items.translation: Benzinimiz **qoldimi** yoki keyingi shoxobchada to'xtashimiz kerakmi?

blocks.text: Bitta so'z — otdan oldin, ibora — otdan keyin

**-ing / -ed** yolg'iz o'zi kelsa, oddiy sifat kabi **otdan oldin** turadi: a **crying** baby, a **broken** window, **stolen** goods. Yoniga boshqa so'zlar qo'shilsa (kim tomonidan, qayerda, qachon), butun ibora **otdan keyin** o'tadi: a baby **crying** in the next room, a window **broken** by the storm. O'zbekchada esa hamma narsa otdan oldin keladi — shuning uchun «the **injured in the accident** boy» kabi xato tez-tez uchraydi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «the woman **who talking** to Tom» → the woman **talking** to Tom (yoki who **is** talking); faol va majhulni adashtirish: «people **injuring** in the accident» → **injured**, «a letter **writing** in 1900» → **written**; so'z tartibi: «the injured in the accident boy» → the boy **injured in the accident**; «There is a man **waits** outside» → There's a man **waiting** outside; noto'g'ri fe'llarda «-ed»: «a house **builded**» → **built**.

O'zingizdan so'rang: ot harakatni **o'zi bajaryaptimi** (o'zi kutyapti, o'zi gaplashyapti) — **-ing**; ot harakatni **qabul qilyaptimi** (uni qurishgan, uni jarohatlashgan) — **-ed / V3**. O'zbekcha qo'shimchalar ham yordam beradi: «kut**ayotgan**» → waiting, «kut**ilgan**» → expected.

68-darsdagi -ing gaplar bilan adashtirmang: He hurt his knee **playing** football — u yerda -ing butun gapga (qachon, qanday) tegishli. Bu darsda esa -ing / -ed iborasi bitta **otga** tegishli va aniqlovchi vazifasini bajaradi: the boy **playing** football (= who is playing).

examples.title: **-ing**: the woman **talking** to Tom
examples.description: -ing iborasi = who / which + faol fe'l: ayni paytda yoki o'sha paytda bo'layotgan harakat. O'zbekchada «-yotgan».

sentences.text: Who's the woman **talking** to Tom by the window?
sentences.translation: Deraza yonida Tom bilan **gaplashayotgan** ayol kim?

sentences.text: The man **sitting** next to me on the plane snored for the whole flight.
sentences.translation: Samolyotda yonimda **o'tirgan** odam butun parvoz davomida xurrak otdi.

sentences.text: I didn't recognise the girl **waving** at us from the other side of the street.
sentences.translation: Ko'chaning narigi tomonidan bizga **qo'l silkitayotgan** qizni tanimadim.

sentences.text: Most of the people **working** in this office come from outside Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Bu ofisda **ishlaydigan** odamlarning ko'pchiligi Toshkentdan tashqaridan kelgan.

sentences.text: Can you see the boy **wearing** a red cap? That's my nephew Jasur.
sentences.translation: **Qizil kepka kiygan** bolani ko'ryapsanmi? U jiyanim Jasur.

sentences.text: Students **taking** the exam tomorrow must bring their passports.
sentences.translation: Ertaga **imtihon topshiradigan** talabalar pasportlarini olib kelishi shart.

sentences.text: The police stopped a car **travelling** at 160 kilometres an hour.
sentences.translation: Politsiya soatiga 160 kilometr tezlikda **ketayotgan** mashinani to'xtatdi.

sentences.text: Who were those people **shouting** outside your house last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun uyingiz oldida **baqirayotgan** odamlar kim edi?

sentences.text: Annoyingly, the woman **standing** behind me in the queue kept reading my messages.
sentences.translation: Jahlimni chiqargani — navbatda orqamda **turgan** ayol tinmay xabarlarimni o'qib turdi.

sentences.text: From the hotel balcony we watched the fishermen **mending** their nets on the beach.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona balkonidan sohilda to'rlarini **tuzatayotgan** baliqchilarni tomosha qildik.

examples.title: **-ing** for permanent facts: a path **leading** to ...
examples.description: -ing doimiy xususiyatni ham bildiradi (= which leads, which contains). Holat fe'llari ham bu yerda -ing oladi: containing, belonging, wanting.

sentences.text: A narrow path **leading** down to the lake starts behind the hotel.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona orqasidan ko'lga **tushib boradigan** tor so'qmoq boshlanadi.

sentences.text: Emma works for a company **employing** over two thousand people.
sentences.translation: Emma **ikki mingdan ortiq xodimi bor** kompaniyada ishlaydi.

sentences.text: The police found a bag **containing** documents and a large amount of cash.
sentences.translation: Politsiya **ichida hujjatlar va katta miqdorda naqd pul bo'lgan** sumkani topdi.

sentences.text: The fields **belonging** to my uncle stretch all the way to the river.
sentences.translation: Tog'amga **qarashli** dalalar daryogacha cho'zilib ketgan.

sentences.text: We need a word **meaning** "extremely tired" — any ideas?
sentences.translation: Bizga «haddan tashqari charchagan» degan **ma'noni beradigan** so'z kerak — taklif bormi?

sentences.text: Visitors **arriving** by train can take a taxi from the station.
sentences.translation: Poyezdda **keladigan** mehmonlar vokzaldan taksiga o'tirishlari mumkin.

sentences.text: The new motorway **connecting** Tashkent and Samarkand will cut the journey to three hours.
sentences.translation: Toshkent va Samarqandni **bog'laydigan** yangi avtomagistral yo'lni uch soatgacha qisqartiradi.

sentences.text: Anyone **wanting** a refund should contact the ticket office before Friday.
sentences.translation: Pulini **qaytarib olmoqchi bo'lganlar** juma kunigacha kassaga murojaat qilishi kerak.

sentences.text: This course is ideal for people **hoping** to work abroad.
sentences.translation: Bu kurs chet elda **ishlashni istaganlar** uchun juda mos.

sentences.text: Our flat has a big window **overlooking** the old part of Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramizda Buxoroning eski qismiga **qaragan** katta deraza bor.

examples.title: **-ed**: the boy **injured** in the accident
examples.description: -ed iborasi = who / which + majhul fe'l (was injured, are produced). O'zbekchada «-ilgan / -ingan».

sentences.text: The boy **injured** in the accident is now recovering in hospital.
sentences.translation: Avariyada **jarohatlangan** bola hozir kasalxonada tuzalyapti.

sentences.text: Most of the goods **produced** in this factory are exported to Europe.
sentences.translation: Bu zavodda **ishlab chiqarilgan** mahsulotlarning aksariyati Yevropaga eksport qilinadi.

sentences.text: Did you read the article **published** in yesterday's paper about air pollution?
sentences.translation: Kechagi gazetada havo ifloslanishi haqida **chop etilgan** maqolani o'qidingizmi?

sentences.text: Passengers **affected** by the delay will receive a free meal.
sentences.translation: Kechikishdan **jabr ko'rgan** yo'lovchilarga bepul ovqat beriladi.

sentences.text: Candidates **invited** to the interview must bring a copy of their diploma.
sentences.translation: Suhbatga **taklif qilingan** nomzodlar diplomining nusxasini olib kelishi kerak.

sentences.text: Only three of the paintings **damaged** in the fire could be restored.
sentences.translation: Yong'inda **shikastlangan** rasmlardan faqat uchtasini qayta tiklash mumkin bo'ldi.

sentences.text: We ordered the dish **recommended** by the waiter, and it was delicious.
sentences.translation: Ofitsiant **tavsiya qilgan** taomga buyurtma berdik — juda mazali ekan.

sentences.text: Is this the parcel **delivered** to the wrong address last week?
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta noto'g'ri manzilga **yetkazilgan** posilka shumi?

sentences.text: Most people **questioned** in the survey said they wanted more parks.
sentences.translation: So'rovnomada **so'ralgan** odamlarning ko'pchiligi ko'proq bog' istashlarini aytdi.

sentences.text: Any luggage **left** unattended will be removed by security staff.
sentences.translation: **Qarovsiz qoldirilgan** har qanday yukni xavfsizlik xodimlari olib ketadi.

examples.title: Irregular participles: **built**, **written**, **stolen**
examples.description: Noto'g'ri fe'llarda -ed emas, uchinchi shakl (V3): built, stolen, written, made, held, spoken, taken, known.

sentences.text: The Kalyan Minaret, **built** in 1127, survived even Genghis Khan.
sentences.translation: 1127-yilda **qurilgan** Minorai Kalon hatto Chingizxon bosqinidan ham omon qolgan.

sentences.text: Most of the money **stolen** from the bank was never found.
sentences.translation: Bankdan **o'g'irlangan** pulning ko'p qismi hech qachon topilmadi.

sentences.text: I love reading the letters **written** by my grandfather during the war.
sentences.translation: Bobomning urush yillarida **yozgan** xatlarini o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman.

sentences.text: Cars **made** in Germany are usually expensive to repair.
sentences.translation: Germaniyada **ishlab chiqarilgan** mashinalarni ta'mirlash odatda qimmat.

sentences.text: The meeting **held** last Tuesday lasted almost four hours.
sentences.translation: O'tgan seshanba **o'tkazilgan** yig'ilish qariyb to'rt soat davom etdi.

sentences.text: Uzbek is one of the languages **spoken** in the south of Kazakhstan.
sentences.translation: O'zbek tili Qozog'iston janubida **so'zlashiladigan** tillardan biri.

sentences.text: Everything **sold** in this little shop is handmade by local women.
sentences.translation: Bu kichik do'konda **sotiladigan** hamma narsani mahalliy ayollar qo'lda tayyorlagan.

sentences.text: The photos **taken** on our honeymoon are still on my old phone.
sentences.translation: Asal oyimizda **olingan** suratlar hali ham eski telefonimda turibdi.

sentences.text: Sarah couldn't open the file **sent** to her by the client.
sentences.translation: Sara mijoz **yuborgan** faylni ocha olmadi.

sentences.text: A man **known** to everyone as "Uncle Bobur" runs the little shop on our street.
sentences.translation: Hammaga «Bobur aka» nomi bilan **tanilgan** kishi ko'chamizdagi kichik do'konni yuritadi.

examples.title: **-ing** or **-ed**? **employing** / **employed**
examples.description: Juft gaplar: ot harakatni o'zi bajarsa — -ing, harakat uning ustida bajarilsa — -ed / V3.

sentences.text: The people **organising** the festival are all volunteers.
sentences.translation: Festivalni **tashkil qilayotgan** odamlarning hammasi ko'ngillilar.

sentences.text: This year's festival, **organised** entirely by volunteers, attracted thousands of visitors.
sentences.translation: Bu yilgi festival — **butunlay ko'ngillilar tomonidan tashkil qilingan** — minglab mehmonlarni jalb qildi.

sentences.text: A company **employing** five hundred people has just opened in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Farg'onada besh yuz kishini **ish bilan ta'minlaydigan** kompaniya endigina ochildi.

sentences.text: Most people **employed** by the company live in nearby villages.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyada **ishlaydigan** odamlarning aksariyati yaqin qishloqlarda yashaydi.

sentences.text: Teachers **marking** exam papers this week can work from home.
sentences.translation: Bu hafta imtihon varaqalarini **tekshirayotgan** o'qituvchilar uydan ishlashi mumkin.

sentences.text: Exam papers **marked** in red pen must be returned to the office.
sentences.translation: Qizil ruchka bilan **tekshirilgan** imtihon varaqalari ofisga qaytarilishi kerak.

sentences.text: Drivers **using** their phones at the wheel will be fined.
sentences.translation: Rul ortida telefondan **foydalanayotgan** haydovchilar jarimaga tortiladi.

sentences.text: Mobile phones **used** in class will be taken away by the teacher.
sentences.translation: Dars paytida **ishlatilgan** telefonlarni o'qituvchi olib qo'yadi.

sentences.text: The boy **bitten** by the dog had to have an injection.
sentences.translation: It **tishlagan** bola ukol olishi kerak bo'ldi.

sentences.text: The dog **biting** everyone in the park belongs to our new neighbours.
sentences.translation: Bog'da hammani **tishlayotgan** it yangi qo'shnilarimizniki ekan.

examples.title: **there is** ... **-ing** / **-ed** and **left**
examples.description: there is / are + ot + -ing / -ed: kimdir kutyapti, kimdir jarohatlandi. left — «qolgan, ortib qolgan».

sentences.text: Excuse me, there's someone **waiting** for you in reception.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, qabulxonada sizni bir kishi **kutyapti**.

sentences.text: There were dozens of tourists **taking** photos of the Registan at sunset.
sentences.translation: Kun botayotganda o'nlab sayyohlar Registonni **suratga olishayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Is there anybody **sitting** in this seat, or can I take it?
sentences.translation: Bu joyda kimdir **o'tiribdimi** yoki o'tirsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: We've got no milk **left**, so I'll have my coffee black.
sentences.translation: Sutimiz **qolmabdi**, shuning uchun qahvani sutsiz ichaman.

sentences.text: There were three people **injured** in the crash on the motorway.
sentences.translation: Avtomagistraldagi avariyada uch kishi **jarohatlandi**.

sentences.text: Is there any cake **left**, or did the kids eat it all?
sentences.translation: Tort **qoldimi** yoki bolalar hammasini yeb qo'yishdimi?

sentences.text: Look, there's a strange man **standing** outside our gate.
sentences.translation: Qara, darvozamiz oldida notanish bir odam **turibdi**.

sentences.text: After the party, we had very little food **left** over.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatdan keyin juda oz ovqat **ortib qoldi**.

sentences.text: There are only two tickets **left** for Saturday's concert.
sentences.translation: Shanbadagi konsertga atigi ikkita chipta **qoldi**.

sentences.text: How much money have we got **left** after paying the rent?
sentences.translation: Ijara haqini to'lagandan keyin qancha pulimiz **qoldi**?

examples.title: In the news: **arrested**, **affected**, **living**
examples.description: Yangiliklar uslubi: -ing va -ed iboralari gapni ixcham qiladi. Har bir gapda ot kim — harakatni bajaruvchimi yoki qabul qiluvchimi?

sentences.text: Two men **arrested** after the robbery have been released without charge.
sentences.translation: O'g'irlikdan keyin **hibsga olingan** ikki kishi ayblovsiz qo'yib yuborildi.

sentences.text: Families **living** near the river have been told to leave their homes.
sentences.translation: Daryo yaqinida **yashovchi** oilalarga uylarini tark etish buyurildi.

sentences.text: Flights **cancelled** because of the storm will be rescheduled for tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron sababli **bekor qilingan** reyslar ertangi kunga ko'chiriladi.

sentences.text: A report **published** today shows that young people are reading fewer books.
sentences.translation: Bugun **e'lon qilingan** hisobot yoshlar kamroq kitob o'qiyotganini ko'rsatadi.

sentences.text: Police are looking for a man **seen** near the bank on Monday evening.
sentences.translation: Politsiya dushanba kuni kechqurun bank yaqinida **ko'rilgan** erkakni qidirmoqda.

sentences.text: Shops **selling** cigarettes to teenagers will lose their licence.
sentences.translation: O'smirlarga sigaret **sotayotgan** do'konlar litsenziyasidan mahrum bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The new hospital, **built** in just eighteen months, opens next week.
sentences.translation: Atigi o'n sakkiz oyda **qurilgan** yangi shifoxona kelasi hafta ochiladi.

sentences.text: Farmers **affected** by the drought will receive help from the government.
sentences.translation: Qurg'oqchilikdan **zarar ko'rgan** fermerlar hukumatdan yordam oladi.

sentences.text: Scientists **studying** the glacier say it has lost a third of its ice.
sentences.translation: Muzlikni **o'rganayotgan** olimlarning aytishicha, u muzining uchdan bir qismini yo'qotgan.

sentences.text: Most of the people **evacuated** from the area have now returned home.
sentences.translation: Hududdan **evakuatsiya qilingan** odamlarning aksariyati endi uylariga qaytdi.

examples.title: Mixed: everyday situations
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: -ing (faol, hozir yoki doimiy), -ed / V3 (majhul) va left — kundalik hayotdan.

sentences.text: The guy **fixing** our boiler says it's at least twenty years old.
sentences.translation: Qozonimizni **tuzatayotgan** usta uning kamida yigirma yillik ekanini aytyapti.

sentences.text: I found an envelope **containing** photos of my parents' wedding.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamning to'y suratlari **solingan** konvertni topib oldim.

sentences.text: For the ceremony Dilnoza wore a dress **made** by her grandmother.
sentences.translation: Marosimga Dilnoza buvisi **tikkan** ko'ylakni kiydi.

sentences.text: Who's that guy **dancing** with Madina? I've never seen him before.
sentences.translation: Madina bilan **raqs tushayotgan** yigit kim? Uni ilgari hech ko'rmaganman.

sentences.text: Bread **baked** in a tandoor tastes completely different.
sentences.translation: Tandirda **yopilgan** nonning ta'mi butunlay boshqacha.

sentences.text: Is there any coffee **left** in the pot, or shall I make some more?
sentences.translation: Qahvadonda qahva **qoldimi** yoki yana damlaymi?

sentences.text: Children **born** after 2010 have never known a world without smartphones.
sentences.translation: 2010-yildan keyin **tug'ilgan** bolalar smartfonsiz dunyoni hech qachon ko'rishmagan.

sentences.text: We stayed in a guesthouse **run** by a lovely old couple from Khiva.
sentences.translation: Xivalik yoqimli keksa er-xotin **yuritadigan** mehmon uyida qoldik.

sentences.text: Anyone **caught** cheating in the exam will have to leave the room.
sentences.translation: Imtihonda ko'chirayotganda **qo'lga tushgan** har kim xonani tark etishi kerak.

sentences.text: The noise **coming** from the flat upstairs kept us awake until three.
sentences.translation: Yuqori qavatdagi kvartiradan **kelayotgan** shovqin bizni soat uchgacha uxlatmadi.
